SQ_START_SQL.title: Open the Simple Quote now (move START_DATE to the past)
SQ_START_SQL.instructions: In DBeaver (SIT connection only): UPDATE NGEP_SIT.SC_QUOTE SET START_DATE = TO_DATE('{NOW_MINUS_1H}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') WHERE QUOTE_NO = '{SQ}'; COMMIT;  Do NOT change END_DATE yet. Then wait until {SQ} shows in the supplier's Simple Quote Respond list.
SQ_START_SQL.source: memory sq-date-sql-procedure (user procedure, 2026-11-04); SQ260000000002276 was lost by closing before the reply

SQ_END_SQL.title: Close the Simple Quote (move END_DATE to the past) — only after the supplier replied
SQ_END_SQL.instructions: In DBeaver (SIT connection only): UPDATE NGEP_SIT.SC_QUOTE SET END_DATE = TO_DATE('{NOW_MINUS_1H}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') WHERE QUOTE_NO = '{SQ}'; COMMIT;  Then wait until the Prepare Request Note task for {SQ} appears in the requisitioner's My Task.

PO_LOOKUP.title: Purchase Order number after iGFMAS verification
PO_LOOKUP.instructions: iGFMAS creates the PO some time after {PR} is approved (about 1 h on 2026-11-16). Find it in DBeaver (NGEP_SIT.FL_FULFILMENT_REQUEST / FL_FULFILMENT_ORDER) or Task Status Search, then: npm run qa -- gate --run {RUN} --gate PO_LOOKUP --set PO=PO26…
PO_LOOKUP.source: knowledge/defects.md DEF-2 (delay, not a defect); memory debit-credit-note-procedure step 5

CO_LOOKUP.title: Contract Order number after iGFMAS verification
CO_LOOKUP.instructions: iGFMAS creates the CO some time after {CR} is approved. Find it in DBeaver (NGEP_SIT.FL_FULFILMENT_ORDER) or Task Status Search, then: npm run qa -- gate --run {RUN} --gate CO_LOOKUP --set CO=CO26…
CO_LOOKUP.source: knowledge/defects.md DEF-2; data-overrides KAT-059 (CO260000000005848 from CR260000000005449)

DO_LOOKUP.title: Delivery Order number in the receiving officer's Group Task
DO_LOOKUP.instructions: The delivery submitted against {PO|CO} becomes a Delivery Order (e.g. 01309H005M2600503) in the receiving officer's Group Task. Find it there or in DBeaver, then: npm run qa -- gate --run {RUN} --gate DO_LOOKUP --set DO=<number>

LA_LOOKUP.title: Letter of Acceptance to build on
LA_LOOKUP.instructions: Give an LA that is already verified by the Desk Officer (KAT-010/027) and belongs to your test data: npm run qa -- gate --run {RUN} --gate LA_LOOKUP --set LA=LA26…
LA_LOOKUP.source: flow design: CT and contract fulfilment start from an existing LOA

CT_LOOKUP.title: Contract (or its LOA) for a Contract Request
CT_LOOKUP.instructions: KAT-057 picks the contract by its LOA number (ContractList). Give the LA of a contract whose FD and agreement are approved: npm run qa -- gate --run {RUN} --gate CT_LOOKUP --set LA=LA26…
